Title: Verify a profile can be created with a title and appears in the search
Step Action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the Profile editor role>
Step Expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

Step Action: Click Create Profile in the main menu
Step Expected: The Create new profile page is displayed

Step Action: Enter "ADO-TEST <unique test title with date>" in the profile title
Step Expected: The title is shown in the title box

Step Action: Click the Create profile button
Step Expected: The profile is created and a confirmation or the Manage profile page is displayed

Step Action: Open Search disease profiles, search for the new title and click Search profiles
Step Expected: The new profile is listed in the results

Step Action: Delete the profile version created for this test (Manage profile, Delete)
Step Expected: The test data is removed

Title: Verify a profile title of 255 characters can be saved
